title: afzelia rhomboidea
intro: Afzelia rhomboidea, commonly known as the African tree or the azobe tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Afzelia rhomboidea include acting as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which help in reducing pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
